Ravi Menon: Quick check-in: ran a 90-day recurrence scan and found 4 frequent failure clusters. Need owners + SLA-adjusted timelines so we can close PM follow-ups.

Ravi Menon: Clusters: 1) KV/prefix rebuild storms, 2) autoscaler oscillation on bursty pools, 3) GPU cold-start tail on scale-ups, 4) rare quantized decode stalls for long sessions. Also flagging customer-impacting rate-limit spikes as a separate item.

Elena Ruiz: I'll own KV/prefix rebuilds. Plan: repro harness, cheaper locking tweaks, and short stale-serving fallback behind a flag. Proposed ETA for RFC + repro: 10 business days (1967776400).

Samir Das: I'll take autoscaler oscillation. Short-term SLA: increase stabilization and add an oscillation detector; long-term: revise scaling policy. PR for config changes by EOD Thu (1967775750).

Priya Singh: I'll coordinate GPU warmup investigation with model infra. If drivers are implicated we'll either rollback or land a warmup preload. Initial correlation report in 5 days (1967776060).

Ravi Menon: Good. For decode stalls, Priya can triage and create a modelops ticket if repro is found.

IncidentBot: Created INC-5234 ("KV prefix rebuild - recurring"), INC-5235 ("Autoscaler oscillation - recurring") and linked them to this thread.

Elena Ruiz: Adding acceptance criteria to INC-5234: reproducible harness, rollback plan for fallback, and no increased error-rate during canary.

Samir Das: Adding monitoring dashboard for oscillation metric to INC-5235 and will schedule a short smoke run after config rollout.

Ravi Menon: Actions summary: Elena INC-5234 repro+RFC (ETA 10 business days), Samir INC-5235 config PR + dashboard (PR by Thu), Priya GPU warmup correlation report (ETA 5 days), Priya/modelops create ticket for decode stalls if repro. We'll do a 15-min owners sync next Tuesday; otherwise post progress here.

Priya Singh: Noted. I'll drop early traces into INC-5234 so Elena can use them for the repro harness.

Ravi Menon: Thanks all  aim to close these follow-ups within the quarter. Ping #eng-oncall if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
